text: 草稿历史（Draft History）是面向 DSH 网页端的会话草稿管理插件，在输入框旁提供草稿历史面板。它会在输入暂停后按会话保存纯文本版本，也可手动保存；用户可以搜索、预览、复制、插入或在确认后替换当前草稿，并删除单条或清空本会话历史。替换前会备份当前非空文本，并在含附件、引用或提交进行中时禁用整段替换。历史保存在当前 DSH 来源的浏览器本地存储，不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

Draft History adds a panel beside the DSH composer. It saves plain-text drafts by conversation and supports search, preview, copy, insertion, confirmed replacement and deletion. History stays in local storage; no API key or external service is needed.
误清空 DSH 输入框后，怎样找回之前写的草稿？
想按会话自动保存输入内容的历史版本。
How can I recover an earlier draft from a DSH conversation?
草稿历史的自动保存：输入暂停约 900 毫秒后，插件按当前会话记录纯文本版本；页面离开或会话切换时会尽量刷新待保存内容。
草稿历史的查找与恢复：面板可搜索并预览历史，可复制或插入到当前光标位置；确认替换前会备份现有文本，并限制含附件、引用或正在提交时替换。
dsh-draft-history 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 14 天；提交数 4；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

**刚写好的需求误清空了？先预览这个会话的旧版本，再安全恢复。**

实际插件组件，隔离测试宿主，合成内容。

给 DeepSeek Harness 输入框多一份后悔药。按会话记录草稿版本，误清空、改坏后可以预览、搜索和恢复。

dsh-draft-history README · 安装与使用：在 DSH「插件 → 添加插件」中填写以下 GitHub 仓库地址（也可使用本地插件目录）；按宿主提示启用及重新加载。需要 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2 或更新的 0.2.x**。它是原生 DSH 插件，无须安装浏览器扩展，不调用模型。

```text
https://github.com/yxue301603/dsh-everyday-plugins#path:/packages/dsh-draft-history
```

整套安装、迁移和升级步骤见[工具箱安装指南](https://github.com/yxue301603/dsh-everyday-plugins/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md)。

输入框旁点击「草稿历史」。输入停止约 0.9 秒时自动记录；在发送、清空或离开会话前尽量保存最后一份文本。也可以点击「保存当前」立即保存。DSH 自带草稿持久化继续正常工作；插件不会在你进入会话时自行覆盖输入框。

dsh-draft-history README · 安装与使用：- 每个会话独立，历史可按内容搜索，支持复制和单条删除。
- 「插入当前草稿」把历史加入当前光标处，保留原有文字和附件；原光标选区不会被删除。
- 「替换当前文本」需要再次确认，先备份当前文本，通过原生修订号校验替换；含附件、引用、正在发送或文本过长时禁用。
- 暂停自动记录后，已有历史仍可使用；手动保存仍可用。
- 清除本会话历史不会清空输入框；同一份未编辑的文本不会立刻被后台重新记入。

dsh-draft-history README · 数据与边界：仅在当前 DSH 浏览器来源的本地存储保存**纯文本**。不上传、不访问密钥、不记录附件本体，不恢复文件、命令和引用芯片的语义关系；引用在历史里只是其可复制的文字。恢复不会自动发送消息。已发送的输入也可能保留为编辑历史，恢复前请自行确认。

默认最多 40 个会话，每会话 12 个版本；仅展示最近 30 天记录，新保存时清理超龄记录。每条最多 48,000 个字符，总量最多约 800,000 个字符；达到上限时优先保留较近访问会话的版本，过长草稿不自动截断。页面强制崩溃前最后不到 0.9 秒的编辑可能来不及保存。不同 DSH 来源、机器和浏览器之间不自动同步。

读取损坏记录或写入失败时显示错误，不静默覆盖损坏的原记录。建议先复制重要文本再处理浏览器存储。清除 DSH 站点数据也会移除插件历史。界面支持中文、英文与深浅主题，所有输入只走 DSH 官方接口。

See [English documentation](README.en.md).

dsh-draft-history README · Draft History：A small safety net for the native DeepSeek Harness composer. Browse, search, copy and recover previous drafts without sending anything automatically.

dsh-draft-history README · Install and use：In DSH, open **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter the following GitHub repository URL (or a local package directory). Enable it and reload when requested. Requires DSH **0.2.1-rc.2 or a newer 0.2.x version**. No browser extension or model access is needed.

```text
https://github.com/yxue301603/dsh-everyday-plugins#path:/packages/dsh-draft-history
```

dsh-draft-history README · Install and use：For collection installation, migration and upgrades, see the [installation guide](https://github.com/yxue301603/dsh-everyday-plugins/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md#english-quick-guide).

dsh-draft-history README · Install and use：Open **Draft history** beside the composer. A version is saved about 900 ms after typing pauses. The last nonempty text is also protected when clearing or leaving a conversation where possible. **Save current** creates an immediate checkpoint. DSH's own draft persistence stays in charge; entering a conversation never overwrites its draft automatically.

dsh-draft-history README · Install and use：- Histories are separate for each conversation and support text search, copying and individual deletion.
- **Insert into draft** inserts at the native selection's end, preserving selected text, existing references and attachments.
- **Replace current text** requires confirmation, backs up current text and uses the native revision guard. It is disabled with attachments, references, an active submission or text beyond the history size limit.
- Pause recording without removing existing history. Manual saving still works while paused.
- Clearing conversation history leaves the composer unchanged and does not immediately record the same unedited text again.

dsh-draft-history README · Storage and limits：Only plain text is kept in browser-local storage for the current DSH origin. No uploads, credentials, attachment bodies or model calls. Reference chips are recorded only as clipboard text and are not restored as references. Previously sent text may remain in editing history; review it before reusing it.

dsh-draft-history README · Storage and limits：Up to 40 conversations, 12 versions per conversation, 48,000 characters per version and approximately 800,000 characters overall. The UI shows the last 30 days; later saves remove expired entries. Older versions are trimmed when needed. Oversized drafts are skipped rather than truncated. A forced crash may lose the final typing interval. Histories do not automatically synchronize across origins, browsers or machines.

dsh-draft-history README · Storage and limits：Read and write failures are visible. Corrupt records are not silently overwritten. Clearing DSH site data removes history. Includes Chinese, English and light/dark theme support. Restoration uses official DSH composer actions only.
